pages.title: Zenitsu Agatsuma Standing in His Triangle-patterned Haori with His Nichirin Sword at His Waist Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu Agatsuma standing with his Nichirin sword at his waist, wearing a triangle-patterned haori over his buttoned uniform. The full-length coloring sheet includes tied leg wraps, sandals, and a patterned sword grip, with open clothing sections surrounding the smaller triangles and fastenings.

pages.title: Zenitsu Preparing Thunderclap and Flash with One Hand on His Sword Hilt and the Other on the Scabbard Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu prepares Thunderclap and Flash in this printable coloring page, crouching with closed eyes while gripping his sword hilt and steadying the scabbard. His wide sleeves and triangle-patterned haori spread around the low stance, while the coloring sheet leaves broad trouser panels between smaller details on the handle and leg ties.

pages.title: Chibi Zenitsu Feeding Chuntaro From His Open Palm Beneath a Wisteria Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: Chibi Zenitsu feeds Chuntaro beneath a hanging wisteria branch in this printable coloring page, smiling as the sparrow pecks at seeds in his palm. The coloring sheet contrasts his oversized head and broad sleeves with clusters of small blossoms, outlined feathers, and repeated triangles on his haori.

pages.title: Zenitsu with His Original Dark Hair Taking a Sword Lesson From Jigoro Kuwajima Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu with his original dark hair taking a sword lesson from Jigoro Kuwajima beside a wooden house and garden. Zenitsu grips the raised blade with both hands as his mustached teacher watches, and the coloring sheet combines broad training clothes with trees, grass, and Jigoro's patterned haori.

pages.title: Zenitsu Hiding in a Tree While Jigoro Kuwajima Calls Him Back to Training Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu hides on a tree branch in this printable coloring page while Jigoro Kuwajima stands below, raising one hand to call him back to training. Zenitsu clutches the trunk with a worried expression, and the coloring sheet adds textured bark, individual leaves, distant hills, and triangle patterns on both characters' haori.

pages.title: Zenitsu Flinching as Kaigaku Tosses a Peach During Their Thunder Breathing Training Coloring Page
pages.description: Kaigaku tosses a peach toward a flinching Zenitsu during Thunder Breathing training in this printable coloring page, with their contrasting expressions at the center. The airborne fruit and curved motion marks separate the two figures, while the coloring sheet includes lightning and triangle clothing patterns, a fence, and a house roof.

pages.title: Zenitsu Waiting Beneath the Wisteria Blossoms at Mount Fujikasane Before Final Selection Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Zenitsu beneath hanging wisteria blossoms at Mount Fujikasane before Final Selection, with his hands held tightly near his chest. A stone path, rocks, and a rope between wooden posts surround his full-length figure, giving the coloring sheet small flower shapes beside broader uniform and haori sections.

pages.title: Zenitsu Choosing Ore for His Nichirin Sword After Passing Final Selection Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu chooses ore for his Nichirin sword after Final Selection in this printable coloring page, kneeling behind a low table with four rough stones. His hand rests on one large piece, and the coloring sheet pairs the ore's angular facets with repeated haori triangles, wide sleeves, and simple wooden floorboards.

pages.title: Zenitsu Receiving His Messenger Sparrow Chuntaro After Final Selection Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu receives his messenger sparrow Chuntaro after Final Selection in this printable coloring page, crouching with a smile as the bird perches on his hand. Hanging wisteria frames the pair, with a gateway and rocky path behind them; the coloring sheet includes tiny feather details and larger open folds in Zenitsu's clothing.

pages.title: Zenitsu Meeting Tanjiro Kamado on the Road to Tsuzumi Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu meeting Tanjiro Kamado on the road to Tsuzumi Mansion, with both characters standing face to face along a wooded path. Tanjiro carries the wooden box on his back, while the coloring sheet contrasts his checkered haori with Zenitsu's triangles, adding distant mountains, shrubs, and scattered stones.

pages.title: Zenitsu Listening to the Mysterious Drum Sounds Outside Tsuzumi Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu listens for mysterious drum sounds outside Tsuzumi Mansion in this printable coloring page, leaning toward a tall wooden door with one hand raised. His wide eyes and slightly bent stance stand out against the door planks, while the coloring sheet includes triangle-patterned sleeves, roof tiles, and stepping stones along the wall.

pages.title: Zenitsu Holding Shoichi's Hand as They Walk Through a Rotating Corridor in Tsuzumi Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu holding Shoichi's hand as they walk through a rotating corridor in Tsuzumi Mansion, both wearing startled expressions. Slanted floorboards and rows of sliding doors create a tilted hallway around them, with the coloring sheet leaving broad clothing areas between Zenitsu's haori triangles and Shoichi's tied sash.

pages.title: Zenitsu Fighting the Tongue Demon with His Eyes Closed Inside Tsuzumi Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu fights the Tongue Demon with his eyes closed inside Tsuzumi Mansion in this printable coloring page, holding his drawn sword across a low stance. The demon's long curling tongue, sharp teeth, and raised claws face him, while wooden wall panels and floorboards form the background of this action coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Protecting Nezuko's Wooden Box From Inosuke Outside Tsuzumi Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu protecting Nezuko's wooden box from Inosuke outside Tsuzumi Mansion, crouching around it with both arms wrapped across the front. Inosuke stands behind him wearing his boar mask and holding two serrated swords, while the coloring sheet adds box panels, haori triangles, courtyard stones, and tiled architecture.

pages.title: Zenitsu Blushing as Nezuko Steps Out of Her Wooden Box at the Wisteria House Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu blushes as Nezuko steps out of her wooden box at the Wisteria House in this printable coloring page, kneeling close beside the open doorway. Her long wavy hair, bamboo muzzle, and geometric kimono pattern sit beside his triangle-covered haori, creating distinct smaller sections within the otherwise open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Eating a Bowl of Rice Beside Tanjiro at the Wisteria House Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu eats a bowl of rice beside Tanjiro at the Wisteria House in this printable coloring page, with both seated behind a low dining table. Chopsticks, cups, and small food dishes fill the foreground, while hanging blossoms and sliding screens surround the two patterned haori on this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Sleeping Peacefully on a Futon at the Wisteria House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu sleeping peacefully on a futon at the Wisteria House, with his hands tucked beneath his cheek on the pillow. A large folded blanket provides broad coloring areas, while the coloring sheet adds smaller haori triangles and hanging wisteria blossoms beyond the open sliding window.

pages.title: Zenitsu Pleading with Tanjiro at the Entrance to Mount Natagumo Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu pleads with Tanjiro at the entrance to Mount Natagumo in this printable coloring page, pressing his palms together as Tanjiro points along the forest path. Their sheathed swords, patterned haori, and Tanjiro's box provide distinct details, with tall trunks and low shrubs enclosing the two figures on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Running Away From a Human-headed Spider in the Mount Natagumo Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu running away from a human-headed spider in the Mount Natagumo forest, his mouth open and one leg lifted mid-stride. The spider follows on long jointed legs, while the coloring sheet outlines Zenitsu's flowing triangle-patterned haori, his sheathed sword, tall trees, and small clumps of grass.

pages.title: Zenitsu Using Thunderclap and Flash Sixfold Against the Spider Demon on Mount Natagumo Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu uses Thunderclap and Flash Sixfold against the Spider Demon on Mount Natagumo in this printable coloring page, lunging forward with his eyes closed. Jagged lightning trails wrap around his drawn sword and flaring haori, while a suspended spider figure and web strands add smaller details above the action coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Receiving an Antidote From Shinobu Kocho After the Mount Natagumo Battle Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu receiving an antidote from Shinobu Kocho after the Mount Natagumo battle, seated with one sleeve raised for treatment. Shinobu holds a small syringe beside his upper arm, and her butterfly hair ornament and wing-patterned haori provide fine detail beside the broader shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Making a Tearful Face as Aoi Brings Medicine to His Butterfly Mansion Recovery Bed Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu makes a tearful face as Aoi brings medicine to his Butterfly Mansion recovery bed in this printable coloring page, clutching the blanket with both hands. Aoi carries a cup and saucer beside the bed, while bandages, butterfly hair clips, and rounded bedpost finials add small details to the coloring sheet's large open sections.

pages.title: Zenitsu Reaching for a Medicine Cup During Reflex Training with Aoi at the Butterfly Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu reaches for a medicine cup during reflex training with Aoi at the Butterfly Mansion in this printable coloring page, kneeling beside a low table. Aoi extends her hand above his as three cups line the tabletop, and the coloring sheet includes tied cushions, a flower vase, and the triangles on Zenitsu's haori.

pages.title: Zenitsu Chasing Kanao Tsuyuri During Rehabilitation Tag Training at the Butterfly Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu chasing Kanao Tsuyuri during rehabilitation tag training at the Butterfly Mansion, reaching forward as she runs ahead of him. Kanao's cape and ponytail stream behind her, while butterfly accessories, a sheathed sword, and Zenitsu's flared triangle-patterned sleeves bring smaller details to the garden coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Blowing Into a Training Gourd to Strengthen His Breathing at the Butterfly Mansion Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu blows into a training gourd to strengthen his breathing at the Butterfly Mansion in this printable coloring page, sitting cross-legged and holding it with both hands. The gourd's tied cord and tassels sit between his patterned sleeves, while the coloring sheet adds a bed, window frame, and small vase of flowers behind him.

pages.title: Zenitsu Practicing Total Concentration Breathing While Seated in the Butterfly Mansion Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu practices Total Concentration Breathing while seated in the Butterfly Mansion garden in this printable coloring page, closing his eyes with his hands resting on his knees. His crossed legs and spreading haori occupy most of the coloring sheet, with repeated triangles, individual leaves, and a curved stepping-stone path adding smaller areas.

pages.title: Zenitsu Waving Goodbye to the Butterfly Mansion Helpers Before Leaving on His Next Mission Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu waving goodbye to the Butterfly Mansion helpers before his next mission, turning back while stepping away from the gateway. Three apron-wearing helpers wave beneath the tiled entrance roof, and the coloring sheet combines broad clothing panels with butterfly hair clips, haori triangles, and a short stepping-stone path.

pages.title: Zenitsu Trying to Stop Inosuke From Challenging the Mugen Train at the Station Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu tries to stop Inosuke from challenging the Mugen Train at the station in this printable coloring page, reaching toward him with both palms raised. Inosuke faces the locomotive in his boar mask, while the coloring sheet includes the large circular engine front, headlamp, rails, and the contrasting textures of fur and patterned cloth.

pages.title: Zenitsu Watching Kyojuro Rengoku Enjoy a Boxed Meal Aboard the Mugen Train Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu watching Kyojuro Rengoku enjoy a boxed meal aboard the Mugen Train, sitting beside him with his hands against his cheeks. Rengoku holds chopsticks above the food box, and the coloring sheet contrasts his flame-edged cape with Zenitsu's triangles beneath a window and overhead luggage rack.

pages.title: Zenitsu Asleep on a Mugen Train Bench with Enmu's Dream Rope Around His Wrist Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu sleeps on a Mugen Train bench with Enmu's dream rope tied around his wrist in this printable coloring page, his head tilted and eyes closed. The rope extends beyond the seat, while the coloring sheet adds a wide carriage window, overhead rack, floorboards, and repeated triangles across his haori and leg wraps.

pages.title: Zenitsu Walking Hand in Hand with Nezuko Through the Peach Orchard in His Mugen Train Dream Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Zenitsu walking hand in hand with Nezuko through the peach orchard from his Mugen Train dream, smiling beneath fruit-laden branches. Their full-length figures fill the coloring sheet, with large peaches overhead, loose leaves along the path, Zenitsu's haori triangles, and geometric panels across Nezuko's kimono.

pages.title: Zenitsu Rescuing Nezuko From Enmu's Tentacles Inside a Mugen Train Carriage Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu rescues Nezuko from Enmu's tentacles inside a Mugen Train carriage in this printable coloring page, standing before her with his sword cutting through one tendril. Thick curling tentacles frame the pair, while rows of seats, luggage racks, and ceiling lamps give this coloring sheet a carriage interior filled with smaller structural details.

pages.title: Zenitsu Placing Nezuko Safely Inside Her Wooden Box Beside the Derailed Mugen Train at Sunrise Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu placing Nezuko inside her wooden box beside the derailed Mugen Train at sunrise, kneeling with one hand on her shoulder. The open box fills the foreground, while broken rails, tilted carriages, and a sun rising over distant hills add varied outlined sections to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Disguised as Zenko in a Kimono Arriving at Kyogoku House with Tengen Uzui Coloring Page
pages.description: Zenitsu arrives at Kyogoku House disguised as Zenko in this printable coloring page, wearing a floral kimono and standing beside Tengen Uzui at the entrance. A small drawstring pouch hangs from Zenitsu's hands, while Tengen's jeweled headband, matching armbands, and the doorway's paired lanterns provide finer details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Disguised as Zenko Playing the Shamisen at Kyogoku House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu disguised as Zenko playing the shamisen at Kyogoku House, seated on a cushion in a flower-patterned kimono and hair ornaments. The instrument crosses his lap with its long neck raised, while a round window, flowering vase, sash cords, and tassels add small sections throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Stopping Daki From Hurting a Young Attendant Inside Kyogoku House Coloring Page

pages.title: Zenitsu Trapped Inside Daki's Patterned Obi Sash in Her Underground Chamber Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Zenitsu trapped inside Daki's patterned obi sash in her underground chamber, with fabric wrapped tightly around his body and arms. Loose sash ends curl outward on both sides, filling the coloring sheet with large flowers, diagonal bands, and geometric sections against a lightly outlined rocky background.

pages.title: Zenitsu Slicing Daki's Obi Sashes with Thunder Breathing in the Underground Chamber Coloring Page

Daki stands behind him with flowing hair and raised hands, while geometric ribbon motifs and Zenitsu's haori triangles add repeated details across the action coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zenitsu Using Thunderclap and Flash Godspeed Against Daki Above the Entertainment District Rooftops Coloring Page

pages.title: Zenitsu Resting Beside Nezuko Amid the Ruins After the Entertainment District Battle Coloring Page

Nezuko sits alongside him with her bamboo muzzle and long hair, while broken planks, roof tiles, haori triangles, and kimono patterns supply the coloring sheet's smaller details.

pages.title: Zenitsu Celebrating Nezuko Standing Safely in the Sunlight at the Butterfly Mansion Coloring Page

Nezuko stands beside him without her bamboo muzzle, and the coloring sheet adds butterflies, small garden flowers, tiled roofs, and geometric patterns on their clothing.

pages.title: Zenitsu Running Beside Tanjiro During Tengen Uzui's Stamina Training Coloring Page

pages.title: Zenitsu Facing Sanemi Shinazugawa with a Wooden Practice Sword During Hashira Training Coloring Page

Sanemi's open jacket and outlined scars contrast with Zenitsu's tied training clothes, while the coloring sheet includes leg wraps, a tiled courtyard wall, and a tree behind them.

pages.title: Zenitsu Enduring Waterfall Training at Gyomei Himejima's Mountain Training Ground Coloring Page

pages.title: Zenitsu Hugging a Warm Boulder Beside Murata After the Icy Waterfall Training Coloring Page
